reason: Sewickley Academy (sewickley.org, Sewickley PA, founded 1838) fails on all three axes: (1) SIZE -- 464 students per NCES PSS 2023-24, 515 per U.S. News, 532-533 per PrivateSchoolReview, and NAIS lists its enrollment band as 501-700, i.e. roughly half the low end of Kenneth's 800-2,000-student growth-stage band, the same standard that dropped San Francisco University High School (517-518) and Pomfret (~350); (2) SITUATION -- the school already has entrenched in-house technology leadership, not a governance vacuum: Beau Blaser has been Director of Technology / CIO since Jul 2005 (21 years) and his own profile describes owning 'the overall leadership and supervision of the technology program... organization-wide technology plan, including: program, budget, staffing... as well as a comprehensive security and backup/recovery policy,' alongside a Technology Coordinator (since Aug 2022) and a standing Technology department in the staff directory -- the exact opposite of 'outgrew reactive outsourced IT with no technology leadership'; (3) NO QUOTABLE LINE -- both matched jobs (Assistant to the Head of Middle School, Advancement Assistant) are administrative hires at live=None whose JD excerpts are pure 'ABOUT SEWICKLEY ACADEMY' boilerplate with zero technology-governance content, the pack carries liveness=unverified and no fresh-feed section, and the only tech-adjacent postings findable via Exa are a curricular Computer Science Teacher (one listing already marked expired) and an advancement Database Manager -- neither redescribes board-level cybersecurity, AI, or vendor-governance pain. Note: the Datanyze figures (1,890 employees, $58.8M revenue) are aggregator junk contradicted by the school's own 85.8 FTE faculty count and NCES, and were not relied on.
